{{Quote|I want to know how this happened before sundown today. Then contact Nathe at the Special Operations Brigade. I want the securecam footage from both of Chandrila's public spaceports and all of its private docking bays&mdash;I don't care who owns them&mdash;as well as the footage of every street in a five-klick radius of the dead zone, deconstructed frame by frame.|Bail Organa, to Minala Lodilyn|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />}}
'''Nathe''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a member of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]], a [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] division of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />

Following a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] attack on [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], the representative to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for the world of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], ordered his assistant [[Minala Lodilyn]] to summon Nathe and [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Varrak]] to obtain for him security footage of the attack.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
